64-bit game now runs inside mihawkos itself, with a page-table pool of 16,384 instead of 8,192: the limit that made large games crash or close one file to install. the windows runtime ships inside the ppsa99170 folder. no usb drive, no second download: mihawkos installs and updates its runtime by itself a new main menu. a tile grid on a sky, a file browser that starts any program, options for each game, an on-screen keyboard, and ten languages in this release games inside mihawkos install and updates the main menu games and graphics steam payloads and logs played on the console known limits installing or updating source and credits games inside mihawkos twice the page tables. a 64-bit game runs inside the mihawkos title instead of in a separate helper, so it gets the title s pool of 16,384 page tables instead of the helpers 8,192. steam, launchers, installers and web-based programs keep running the old way only real games go inside. a program that draws with directx or opengl is treated as a game; launchers installers, crash reporters, web-technology games nw.js, electron and .net tools run the old way a crashed or frozen game returns you to mihawkos instead of hanging the console. a game that shows no new picture for 3 minutes is closed, and the log records what it was waiting for message boxes are visible. an error or message box from a game inside mihawkos is shown on screen, and cross answers it. before, it was invisible and the game looked frozen heavy games no longer freeze the whole console : games inside mihawkos run at a lower cpu priority than the console s own work your choice, per game: press triangle on a game for its options, including run inside mihawkos or the old way install and updates one folder. the runtime is inside ppsa99170 runtime-pieces runtime: it wrote only the 18 files that changed 75.8 mb in 12.9 seconds, and all 2,565 runtime files then matched the new package. the final build updated over the one before it the same way automatic update check. mihawkos asks github for the list of releases, sends nothing about you or your console and accepts only updates signed with mihawkos s own key. to turn it off: settings, aero tile grid on a sky. mihawk os and steam have their own tiles; your games follow page by page l1 r1 . move with the d-pad, or with the hand pointer on the left stick files. browse your windows screen used with their permission the your browser companion tile shows the qr code for the web ui. steam has its own icon, settings has a cog, and the button hints are centred games and graphics frames reach the screen sooner. copying each finished frame to the tv went from about 7.4 ms to under 1 ms, so every game has more time for its own work. checked on a ps5 pro with the witcher 3 and with our own test picture directx 12 feature level 12 1 it was 11 1 . games that require 12 0 get past your gpu does not meet the minimum . games that create shared directx 12 resources no longer fail at start games see the real gpu: amd radeon playstation 5 gpu or playstation 5 pro gpu , with the real number of compute units and clock speeds, through directx and amd s ags library more reserved graphics memory pieces: up to 32,768 it was 4,096 , refused only when the console s page tables really run low undertale, deltarune and other gamemaker games start. a small shared section in their program could not be mapped with the ps5 s larger memory pages; it now is deltarune s sound stays clean after switching chapters. a game whose launcher starts a second program now shares one sound clock between them movies shared between directx 9 and directx 11 work when the game creates its directx 11 side first games installed through steam carry their steam app id , so wine s built-in game workarounds apply and steamworks sees the game as started by steam a mod s dll override for example in the web ui s environment field no longer switches off mihawkos s graphics layers a game that loses its controller and gets it back is told so, and finds the controller again a 64-bit game may reserve far more address space some ask for 16 to 256 gib at once , which the console used to refuse fewer crashes in games that use xaudio2 sound; opengl games that set their pixel format twice no longer fail; a start-up deadlock in some programs is fixed; older games cpu checks no longer trip games that place graphics memory over their own memory directx 12 existing heaps , used for example by a forza horizon 2 pc recompilation can now do it inside mihawkos. checked with our own test program on a ps5 pro, not yet with that game a game can read the program that started it , even when that program runs separately the mihawk os desktop for example , and gets the same answers as on windows a program can read another program s command line , as on windows. launchers and web-technology games that check how their own programs were started now get the answer a game that cannot start for example, a missing dll no longer leaves mihawkos stuck: you re back at the launcher, which says last session ended: game.exe could not start: x.dll was not found steam big downloads no longer close steam. a memory-saving feature for steam s web pages took most of the console s file slots, so a download with many files ran out and steam closed. it is capped now, and open files always come first over 10,000 files open at once it was about 8,200 , checked on a ps5 pro: 10,000 files opened, written, read back and closed steam memory warning. before steam installs or starts, mihawkos warns if your ps5 is already using too much memory for steam to work, and lists the steps that fix it. press circle to go back, or hold triangle for 5 seconds to continue anyway steam cloud tip: if cloud saves never download, check the ps5 s own dns settings, network, connection status . a dns server that blocks storage.googleapis.com stops steam s downloads from google s storage while the other providers 431055676.body: ps5 mihawkos-v7.1.0-alpha-7 mihawkos is a passion project, not a piracy project it exists so you can play the games you own on the console you own piracy is not condoned no games, saves, keys, firmware or exploits are included, and they never will be use only games and programs you have the right to run : your own copies, bought or installed by you requests for, or links to, games, keys, firmware or exploits are not welcome in this project s issues or discussions mihawkos s own on-screen keyboard. games inside mihawkos no longer freeze waiting for input. updates that say what they re doing an update to the seventh alpha of mihawkos, the homebrew title that runs windows games on a ps5 from a desktop of their own, mihawk os. it is still experimental. from alpha 7, update by replacing the ppsa99170 folder alpha 7 s own update cannot install it ; from 7.1 on, mihawkos updates itself mihawkos s own on-screen keyboard it works on every firmware now. alpha 7 borrowed the ps5 s system keyboard, which cannot be loaded by homebrew on firmware 13.60, so the keyboard never opened there. mihawkos now draws its own at the bottom of the screen, with the game visible above it. open it during a game the way you chose in settings controls a two-finger touchpad click, l3 r3, or options touchpad click frosted meadow look: see-through frosted glass that shows the game blurred behind it, glossy aero keys, soap bubbles rising at its sides, and a soft light that crosses the glass once after it opens, then at most every 30 seconds, never while you are typing instant. a key press shows on screen 2 to 5 ms later measured on a standard ps5, firmware 13.60 while it is open it costs the game about 3 ms per frame; closed, nothing games inside mihawkos no more freezing until the mouse moves. in alpha 7, a game inside mihawkos could stop for seconds at a time, its music still playing, until a mouse or controller input arrived. a wake-up meant for input stayed set when no input came so the game s main loop spun on it and its timers never fired. our own test program shows it: in alpha 7 its first 16 ms wait never returned in 3 minutes; in 7.1 every wait came back on time longest 17 ms . this test is now part of every release s checks clearer crash reports. when a game inside mihawkos fails to read a part of a file it has mapped into memory, the log now says why, so these crashes can be diagnosed from a report updates the update line says what it s doing , in your language: checking, downloading with mb and percent , checking the signature, preparing with percent , ready. if something goes wrong it says why: the update server could not be reached, the download stopped, there is not enough space, or the download did not match mihawkos s signature it is then not used, and mihawkos stays as it is it checks every time you open mihawkos from the home screen , at most once an hour, instead of once a day returning from a game does not check no double check after an update. mihawkos no longer asks again right after restarting into the new version updates that start. alpha 7 s updater wrote the new version without permission to run its programs, so the updated mihawkos could not start. 7.1 s updater sets it, and reads a new signed file that alpha 7 never sees played on the console this release s build was tested on a standard ps5 firmware 13.60 the full test battery of 121 cases on a freshly restarted console: 119 passed and 2 were skipped by a test-network setting v71-fix-gate-base-2026-11-02 7.1 updating itself to a newer test build: it found it, downloaded it 555 mb , checked its signature, switched and the new version started from the switched folder, its programs allowed to run. its own restart and a return from a game did not check again; opening mihawkos did updating from alpha 7 by replacing the folder: on a console set up with alpha 7 and its runtime, the 7.1 folder was copied over the old one. 7.1 topped up its runtime by itself 12 files, 11.7 seconds , every file matched the package its programs were allowed to run, and the prefix and settings were kept the keyboard: its 5 checks pass on the console opening it, moving and typing, changing pages, closing , with 2 to 5 ms from a key press to the screen known limits tested on a standard ps5 firmware 13.60 only. no ps5 pro was run with this build the input-freeze fix is proven with our test program, not yet with a game. testers who saw a game freeze until they moved the mouse: please try again and send logs spelunky 2 stays on a black screen: it asks for memory at addresses the ps5 does not give to programs. under investigation the witcher 3 started from the mihawk os desktop closes itself at once. start it from the library or files only one game at a time runs inside mihawkos. a second game, and 32-bit games, run the old way a game that freezes on its loading screen may not be closed by itself yet: close mihawkos from the ps button menu restart the ps5 now and then. pipe memory runs out after very many program starts; mihawkos says restart the ps5 when that happens the per-boot setup is yours: your payloads after every cold boot. never use rest mode with payloads loaded not supported: drm such as denuvo, and anti-cheat such as easy anti-cheat or battleye everything else from alpha 7 still applies installing or updating ps5 mihawkos-v7.1.0-alpha-7.zip size: 555.4 mb;
